summary: A new CI check, ci-script-tests, runs the CI scripts' own self-tests that read only scripts/, .github/, .st/, nix/ and a few root files, in a sparse copy holding exactly its declared skip-policy inputs; a pull request that touches none of them reuses an earlier signature. genie-freshness keeps the whole-tree tests, lints, licenses and genie --check (about a minute). Both run their tests in parallel.

replay.detail: CI machinery only; no product protocol, schema, rule or note change.

manual.detail: After merge, once the ci-script-tests job has run green on main, add 'ci-script-tests' to the repository ruleset's required status checks (.github/repo-settings.json.genie.ts) and to the REQUIRED sets of scripts/ci-queue-watch and scripts/check-main-ci.

recovery.detail: Revert the change: genie-freshness again runs every test.
